Emma (Head of Product): quick live Q&A follow from today's all-hands. capturing the most actionable customer win/loss signals and asks. please keep replies short.
Raj (Sales): pipeline signals: we win on predictable latency and clear onboarding; we lose to vendors offering on-prem HSM and hard SLAs.
Sophia (CS): concrete loss: HealthPortal dropped us during pilot — they needed a signed SLA for p95 and an air-gapped deployment option.
Ben (Customer Success): consolidated asks: (1) 1-week private/VPC quickstart, (2) latency tiers + pricing, (3) an eval kit to reproduce regressions, (4) clearer fallback behavior when capacity is constrained.
Lin (Eng PM): minimal VPC quickstart scope: terraform connector, onboarding checklist, KMS examples, runbook. est: 3-4 sprints with a 2-eng pod.
Maria (Applied ML): root cause on regressions: default quant profile flips. mitigation = CI release-check with sampled prompt evals + pinning profiles. low-effort, high-impact.
David (CEO): leadership ask: can product/eng deliver a one-page commitment (scope + owner + risks) by next Tue? we'll review and prioritize.
Emma (Head of Product): will coordinate. Ben/Raj/Lin please draft the "loss playbook" mapping reasons -> mitigations.
allhands-bot: :spiral_calendar: task created: "loss-playbook" owner: Ben, due: 14 days.
Sophia (CS): small ask: include example cost deltas for batching vs latency in any public FAQ — customers want numbers.
Maria (Applied ML): will add sample token-cost numbers to the quant FAQ and a tiny matrix of accuracy impact.
Emma (Head of Product): thanks all  i'll post the one-pager draft and notes here after leadership sync: https://redwoodhq.internal/allhands/1938002222-notes. please keep any follow-ups short so i can convert into tickets. :thumbsup:
